summary: Second T5 batch under the maintainer's go (R131): ru 28, uk 124, pl 64, cs 87, sk 54, sl 58 words from the triage's accepted candidates (278 function words, 69 number words, 48 calendar words, 12 attribution verbs, 7 site chrome, 1 fragment) against the same merged log as group 1 (sha256 6467504ab8ab). Reading each word's other languages left out the ten foreign words the Russian and Ukrainian logs hold (a Russian word hidden through uk would be hidden in Russian too), the English and Latin fragments, three words with a content sense elsewhere (pl maju and amet, sl glede), and four the independent read caught (uk ось, pl jaka, cs mimo, cs dubna). The tool stopped writing the readers' labels into the batch comment and a test fails if they come back. The 415 words are declared in test_analytics_extract. Hidden at query time, no re-index. Left: groups 3 onward (sr bg el, the Asian group, the single-reader languages) and the layout PR.
